description: This PHP class 'TranslationCollection' encapsulates collections of translation data, including mappings from keys to source/target translations, and source-to-target translations, for internationalization purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TranslationCollection
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that manages various collections of translation mappings used for internationalization in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getKeyAndSourceTarget
methods.description: Returns the map of keys to their associated source and target translations.

methods.name: getKeyAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the map of keys directly to their target translations.

methods.name: getSourceAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the map of source strings to target translations.
